dashboard.label: Run Performance
dashboard.description: Compare like runs by distance and terrain. Pace is distance-weighted. Best efforts are derived from continuous time-distance streams and include elapsed pause time. Annual panels use full snapshot history; Full years includes a partial latest year. Comparable YTD ends each year at the import calendar date. Pace is minutes/km or minutes/mile. Confirm CSV cadence units to show steps/min: strides are doubled; existing steps are unchanged. Cadence is weighted by recorded moving duration.
